source_evidence: These benefits allow you to withdraw up to a certain amount each year for as long as you live regardless of market performance.
answer: A guaranteed lifetime withdrawal benefit (GLWB) is an optional living benefit on some variable annuities. It lets you withdraw up to a contract-specified amount each year for as long as you live, even if the investments perform poorly. For example, the source describes a benefit that allows withdrawals of up to 6% of purchase payments each year, even if the contract value falls to zero. A GLWB costs extra, and optional benefits may have restrictions or limitations; withdrawals above a stated amount or taken before a specified age may reduce the benefit.
